meta.description: High-level Fusion Skills for 1000% Scale Up

combat_effect.primary: Collapse a Solar Star into a Void Black Hole. Deals 500% damage to all enemies and pulls them into the center.
combat_effect.secondary: Allies in the safe zone gain 'Event Horizon' shield (absorbs 100% damage for 1 turn).

narrative_effect.description: You tear the fabric of reality, merging light and dark into a point of infinite density.

npc_reactions.Suryanatha: 'You... you have done the impossible. Light and Void, as one?'

combat_effect.primary: Rewind time for all allies to their state 3 turns ago (HP, MP, cooldowns).
combat_effect.secondary: Spawns 'Eternal Flowers' that heal 10% HP per turn for the rest of the battle.

narrative_effect.description: Time flows backward, carrying the scent of flowers that have not yet bloomed.

npc_reactions.Tara: 'It's... it's a miracle. The wounds are just... gone.'
npc_reactions.Laxus: 'Messy timeline work, but effective. I'll allow it.'

combat_effect.primary: Change the terrain of the entire battlefield. Lava becomes Water, Walls become Bridges.
combat_effect.secondary: Delete one non-boss enemy from existence (Banish).

narrative_effect.description: You access the source code of the world and rewrite the environment.

npc_reactions.Mira: 'I... I can't write this down. The ink is changing as I write.'

combat_effect.primary: Summon echoes of every enemy you have defeated this run to attack once.
combat_effect.secondary: Confuse all enemies (50% chance to attack allies).

narrative_effect.description: The ghosts of your past victories rise to fight for you.

npc_reactions.Malakar: 'Hah! A legion of failures! Bring them on!'

combat_effect.primary: Deal damage equal to the total damage you have taken this battle.
combat_effect.secondary: If this kills the target, heal to full HP.

narrative_effect.description: You balance the scales of pain and retribution.

npc_reactions.Kiran: 'A high price, but a fair trade.'
